## What landed (two commits — stage boundaries preserved)

### Stage 1 — `611dfd73` — the scheduled window drive

- `crates/hh-runner/src/schedule.rs` (new): `WindowDecl` (`hh-runner-window/1`, strict decode of the drive packet's `window` member — `declared_harvest_ms` is a **required member**, resolving the ticket's "declared harvest time" ambiguity by declaration, never a silent default) · `ScheduleKind{k_round_interleave, pair_coupled, composed}` — the two declared kinds and their composition (REQ-XH-017) · `build_schedule` — seeded ordering recomputable from `decl.seed` (sha256-keyed); pair units = (task,replicate) O/H pairs; composed couples pairs inside rounds · `first_fit` — first-fit in the engine's recorded order under memory/cpu/model-pool bounds and the declared lookahead `w` (REQ-XB-121; packing changes start times only, never assignment) · `concurrency_c` — `C = min(⌊(host−reserve)/slot_mem⌋, ⌊vcpu/slot_cpus⌋, ⌈K·10⁶/f_ppm⌉ for agent phases)` with `c_inputs` recorded (REQ-XB-214) · `admit` — the dead-man cut-off `now + max(in_flight ∪ candidate deadlines) + declared_harvest ≤ started + D` (REQ-XB-128) · `HarvestManifest` (`hh-runner-harvest/1`, incremental per-settle persist, `covers` every settled slot) · `sweep_experiment` — `podman ps --format '{{.ID}} {{index .Labels "hh-experiment"}}'` → runner-side own-label filter → `rm -f` per target → per-container teardown receipts (REQ-XB-127 — foreign/unlabelled containers never targeted).
- `coordinator.rs::drive_window` — reap → `finish_attempt` → harvest.record → first-fit admission (a unit starts only when **all** open members are engine-eligible — a pair is admitted together or withheld together, never split) → `mark_unadmitted` (never-attempted → `withheld{window_deadline|budget}`; attempted-but-gated retry → `unresolved`, REQ-XH-125) → catalog snapshots = blocks+1 · `close(partial)` when plans stay engine-open · `step_hook: &mut dyn FnMut()` — the declared simulated-clock seam (production `&mut || {}`).
- `finish_attempt` fix (carried): when the launch-armed subject writer lease has expired on the store clock (a worker outliving the manifest's `lease_ttl.writer_ms`), bind via the fenced `acquire_writer` takeover (`bind_or_crash`) — the designed fence, never a bypass.
- `packet.rs`: `window`, `podman_bin` members (declared, never PATH-defaulted).

### Stage 2 — `1b9cdf44` — proxy/mediator supervision

- `crates/hh-runner/src/supervision.rs` (new): `ProxyCtl` — spawn `hh-model-proxy`, `configure` first op, Json-lines ops `register_slot`/`revoke_slot`/`catalog_boundary`/`status`/`stop` (REQ-XC-101 — a process, never a dependency) · `MediatorProc` — spawn `hh-egress-mediator` with the declared argv, consume `ready socket=.. run=..`, kill+reap · `fold_prior_window` — `harvest_window_spend` reimplemented read-only (`Store::verify` + Σ `measurement.cost.attributed` + `proxy_aborted` at bounded-hi; `hh-hosting` is an unreachable dep for the runner, CC1): `unharvested ledger` on absent run, `unverified ledger` on verify failure — **before any process spawns** (X-02, REQ-XH-120) · `SupervisionDecl` strict decode (`proxy{bin,store_root,run_id,listen,lane,credential_env,authorization,prior_ledgers,slice_micros,effort,child_env}`, `mediator{bin,store_root,socket,policy,env_handle,effect_id,participant,run_id,seed,resolve}`, `phase_schedule`) · `resolve_bin` — declared path → `HH_MODEL_PROXY_BIN`/`HH_EGRESS_MEDIATOR_BIN` → `target/debug` sibling.
- `drive_window` integration: supervision opens after `recover`; `slot_open` mints a fresh token **per attempt** (`slot_run_id` = slot id) and stamps `cell.env` (`hh_env::egress_allowlist::cell_env_projection(model_port, token)`) + `cell.grants` (extracted `layer.net.unix_sockets.allow` per phase) into the slot packet; `slot_close` revokes at every settle — replanned or not (X-05); `catalog_boundary` lands at `window_open` + each `block_end` (REQ-XC-119/REQ-XD-111); the `supervised` member records `{proxy_run, proxy_root, proxy_listen, mediator_run}` in the window record.
- DF-R6.7-1's cell-environment leg: `credential_env` is a **name** the proxy resolves internally; the cell env carries the slot token and mandatory `no_proxy` — asserted byte-for-byte that no cell-env member equals the upstream credential.
- `Cargo.toml`: dev-dep `hharness-containment` (fixture policy docs for the mediator spawn test — the admitted test-fixture pattern).

## Deviations / honest limits

- **Size deviation (recorded, AMEND)**: ~3.8k changed source/test lines vs the ≤1700 budget (Stage 1 ≈2.1k, Stage 2 ≈1.8k) — same recorded-deviation precedent as R6.8 (~5.3k via ADR-0427), R6.9, R6.10, R6.11, R6.14. Stage boundary commits preserved as the contract requires.
- `prior_ledgers` folds are byte-mechanical but the **window-id** the proxy records is the prior run id (the `WindowSpend.window_id` convention).
- Mediator spawn legs verify handshake+kill only in the fixture; no bytes flow across its socket in the offline battery (its transport is R6.15-proven).
- `child_env` exists as the fixture seam for the credential env var; production inherits the runner environment — the value never enters a record.
- Simulated-clock drives advance via `step_hook` only; wall-clock drives use the real clock.
- No `cargo doc` regressions expected (doc links kept to public items); macOS `helper_live` flake note stands from prior runs.

## DF-R6.7-1 disposition — **closed**

R6.10 discharged the receipt `leak_scan` leg (recorded in the row). The remaining cell-environment leg now lands and is tested: the packet names `credential_env` — the variable only the forwarding (proxy) process resolves — while `cell_env_projection` puts the per-attempt slot token in `OPENAI_API_KEY`/`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and the test asserts no cell-env member carries the upstream credential value (`r6_16b::ac9_supervised_drive_tokens_grants_and_credential_confinement`, `r6_16::ac9_supervised_drive_end_to_end`). The cell environment carries no upstream credential; only the forwarding process holds it.
